name: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd
title: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd - 543978 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Stainless washer maker pivoting into a new copper-clad laminate (CCL) plant (₹338 cr ECMS-approved, Nov-26 start) with 1,078 cr FY26 base and a 2,500 cr FY28-29 target; capex, QIP and the working-capital build are unproven, and OCF was negative.

utilisation.quote: With the capacity of 69% utilization. We can be reached to the 750 crores of the top line.

capex.peers_comment: Management said other players are also working on this line but none indigenous today.
capex.quote: Total, we are getting the 338 crores of the approval from the ECMS scheme of Central Government of India

triggers.label: CCL 5-line capex ₹338 cr approved
triggers.quote: Total, we are getting the 338 crores of the approval from the ECMS scheme

triggers.label: Receivables ~65 cr → ~175 cr
triggers.quote: the receivables have increased to around 110 crores to 175 crores

triggers.quote: I am not looking any kind of the declines into the next coming months also

guidance.quote: altogether, in a consolidated leader, 1870 to 1800 crores plus 750, that can be reached to 2,500 crores of the top line.
1350 to 1400 would be, ideal, lines, which we have been giving up.
November’26 would be our production, first production coming out.
consolidatedly coming down to the 13% or 14% of EBITDA on a conservative side.

the 13% to 15% can be a tax rate, can be going on into the similar scenario
